from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Prepare the data for regression with statsmodels for p-values
X = sm.add_constant(df_merged[['iv_offshoring_1']])
y_share = df_merged['share_immi_imputed']
y_empl = df_merged['empl_immi_imputed']

# Create a linear regression model for share of immigrant employment
model_share = sm.OLS(y_share, X).fit()

# Create a linear regression model for level of immigrant employment
model_empl = sm.OLS(y_empl, X).fit()

# Get the coefficients and p-values
coefficients_share = model_share.params
p_values_share = model_share.pvalues

coefficients_empl = model_empl.params
p_values_empl = model_empl.pvalues

coefficients_share, p_values_share, coefficients_empl, p_values_empl

import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_1samp

# Extract the coefficients and standard errors from the LinearRegression models
# For share of immigrant employment
coefficients_share = model_share.coef_[0]
std_error_share = np.std(model_share.predict(X) - y_share, ddof=1) / np.sqrt(len(y_share))

# For level of immigrant employment
coefficients_empl = model_empl.coef_[0]
std_error_empl = np.std(model_empl.predict(X) - y_empl, ddof=1) / np.sqrt(len(y_empl))

# Perform t-tests for the coefficients
t_stat_share = coefficients_share / std_error_share
p_value_share = 2 * (1 - ttest_1samp(model_share.predict(X) - y_share, 0).pvalue)

t_stat_empl = coefficients_empl / std_error_empl
p_value_empl = 2 * (1 - ttest_1samp(model_empl.predict(X) - y_empl, 0).pvalue)

t_stat_share, p_value_share, t_stat_empl, p_value_empl
